text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Intestinal Malrotation with Midgut Volvulus (or High-grade Lower GI Obstruction).

The acute onset of bilious vomiting (if present), refusal to feed, and progressive distension with no stool passage strongly suggests a surgical emergency such as malrotation/volvulus or a complete distal obstruction like meconium ileus or ileal atresia. Immediate surgical consultation is indicated pending the return of your ultrasound and X-ray images to confirm the diagnosis.
